query: UPDATE photos SET width=$3,height=$4,orientation=$5,is_hdr=$6,has_gain_map=$6,icc_name=$7,camera_make=$8,camera_model=$9,lens=$10,focal_mm=$11,aperture=$12,shutter=$13,iso=$14,gps_lat=$15,gps_lon=$16,taken_at=coalesce($17,taken_at),dominant_colors=$18,placeholder=$19,kind=CASE WHEN $20 THEN 'raw'::media_kind ELSE kind END,status='ready',failure_reason=NULL,derivative_plan=$21 WHERE id=$1 AND original_hash=$2 AND deleted_at IS NULL
